report: Collective Stock accessibility, SEO, and security audit — second verification pass
verdictReason: One high-severity production blocker remains: no complete authenticated private detail, capability issuance, and private download flow. Medium accessibility, SEO, abuse-control, and future poster-delivery findings also remain.

testedFacts: Build and unit tests passed in the revised workspace.
Playwright E2E: 9 passed and 1 desktop-project skip for a mobile-only contract.
Local homepage Lighthouse scores are Performance 98, Accessibility 100, Best Practices 100, and SEO 100.
Lighthouse LCP is 1807.518 ms, CLS is 0.0003301087551392436, and TBT is 0 ms.
The static distribution has 62 generated route files: 21 division, 20 collection, and 21 public asset pages.
All 62 generated route files have main#main-content and an H1 fallback; sitemap has 63 URLs including home.
Public audit summary exposes missingOrInaccessible 265, publicAssets 21, brokenAssets 0, and unassignedAssets 0.
Sharp 0.35.3 is installed and full npm audit reports zero vulnerabilities.
The shared browser local-preview attempt failed with ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT; repository Chromium/Playwright was used.

Real identity-provider login and token issuance

lighthouse.scopeWarning: Local homepage automated lab audit only; not WCAG certification, field performance, or catalog-wide SEO proof.

findings.title: Mobile archive-search button had no accessible name
findings.testedFact: header.js now sets aria-label Search archive, and both desktop/mobile E2E resolve the trigger by role and name.

findings.title: Desktop mega-menu closure stranded focus
findings.testedFact: Escape closes the menu and header.js restores the Divisions trigger if focus was in the mega-menu.

findings.title: Authenticated private detail/download flow is incomplete
findings.testedFact: Only 21 public asset HTML pages are generated. No capability issuer or authenticated private catch-all route exists. Manifest and download handlers use different token scopes/cookies, while DownloadMenu does not mint or attach an asset capability.
findings.impact: Authorized internal users have no demonstrated production path from login to private detail to private download.
findings.fix: Implement a protected private asset route and a short-lived asset/rendition-scoped capability issuer derived from the authenticated session; add nonce, audience, expiry, revocation, secure delivery, and audit logging.
findings.verification: Black-box signed-out, signed-in, wrong-asset, wrong-rendition, expired, replay, revoked, direct-static, and no-JavaScript tests on a deployed preview.

findings.title: Public route HTML had no crawlable archive body
findings.testedFact: All 62 generated route files now include semantic fallback main and H1 content; public asset fallbacks include preview/alt/dimensions/license context.

findings.title: High-severity Sharp/libvips build-time advisory
findings.testedFact: Sharp 0.35.3 is installed and a fresh full npm audit reports zero vulnerabilities.

findings.title: Search suggestions used an incomplete combobox/listbox model
findings.testedFact: The input now exposes combobox/listbox state, retains DOM focus, updates aria-activedescendant/aria-selected, and cleans state on Escape; desktop/mobile E2E passes.

findings.title: Small accent/footer text failed minimum contrast
findings.testedFact: Derived division index text ratios are 7.27:1 to 15.72:1 on navy; footer legal text is 5.40:1; Lighthouse color-contrast passes.

findings.title: Focus indicator remains low-contrast
findings.testedFact: The translucent teal shadow composites to approximately 1.90 to 1.98 contrast against primary dark surfaces and native outlines are removed.
findings.impact: Keyboard focus may be difficult to perceive despite Lighthouse Accessibility 100.
findings.fix: Use an opaque two-pixel-or-greater outline with offset and at least 3:1 contrast; verify sticky/dialog clipping and forced colors.

findings.title: Lightbox slide changes are not announced
findings.testedFact: Previous/Next replaces title and index, but no live status describes the change and dialog naming remains generic.
findings.fix: Use aria-labelledby for the current title and a restrained polite status for title/index changes while retaining navigation-button focus.

findings.title: Universal 44 by 44 project touch-target contract is not proven
findings.testedFact: Core controls explicitly meet 44 pixels and Lighthouse target-size passes, but some standalone footer/title text links do not declare a 44-pixel hit area.
findings.impact: WCAG 2.5.8 likely passes by 24-pixel/spacing/inline exceptions, but the stricter project requirement lacks complete proof.
findings.fix: Add non-overlapping 44-pixel hit areas to standalone links and computed bounding-box assertions across representative viewports.

findings.title: Empty collection routes are indexable and in the sitemap
findings.testedFact: The 21 public assets occupy only Brand Sheets and UI Mockups, but all 20 collections are in the 63-URL sitemap and have indexable fallback pages.
findings.fix: Omit/noindex empty collections until public content exists, or add substantial intentional editorial content.

findings.title: Structured and social metadata remains incomplete
findings.testedFact: Titles, descriptions, canonicals, and basic Open Graph tags exist, but per-route ImageObject/CollectionPage/BreadcrumbList JSON-LD, Twitter cards, and image sitemap entries do not.
findings.fix: Add safely escaped per-route structured data, social image metadata, Twitter summary-large-image, and image sitemap nodes.

findings.title: Download capabilities were accepted in query strings
findings.testedFact: api/download.js now reads a dedicated header, Bearer header, or dedicated cookie; no query token handling remains.

findings.title: Download abuse controls are absent
findings.testedFact: No 429, Retry-After, per-user/IP quota, concurrency/byte budget, or platform rate-limit integration exists.
findings.fix: Add policy evaluation, quotas, concurrency and byte budgets, 429/Retry-After, token-safe audit logging, and burst/sustained tests.

findings.title: Future private posters can be copied publicly
findings.testedFact: No current private poster is distributed, but copy-public-assets.js recursively copies the whole posters directory before manifest filtering.
findings.fix: Copy only poster/preview paths referenced by public assets and add a private-poster exclusion test.

findings.title: Asset alt text is present but generic
findings.testedFact: Sampled images have alt attributes, but many strings identify category/division more than visible content.
findings.fix: Complete an editorial pass covering composition, significant embedded text, and purpose.

findings.title: Inline-style policy reduces defense in depth
findings.testedFact: CSP script policy is strong and hash-matched, but style-src unsafe-inline remains and manifest values feed inline custom properties.
findings.fix: Validate style tokens strictly, prefer classes/data attributes, and narrow style-src-attr when feasible.

findings.title: Robots file disallows a nonexistent private API path
findings.testedFact: robots.txt disallows /api/private/ while active protected handlers are under /api/; Vercel API headers do correctly emit noindex/noarchive.
findings.fix: Disallow /api/ for clarity and retain the response header.

Add observable download rate limiting with 429 and Retry-After behavior.
Raise focus-visible treatment to at least 3 to 1 and test forced colors.
Noindex or remove empty collections from the sitemap.
Make poster distribution manifest-driven and public-only.
Complete NVDA Chrome and VoiceOver Safari core-flow testing.
Capture live Vercel security and private noindex headers.
